limitations: Natural200 first-choice aggregate remains72/200; no broad real-user accuracy claim.
Old600 gains8 first choices and loses4; public100 gains20 and loses2. Aggregate guards do not preserve every previous first choice.
New authored validation/heldout share constructions with different verb/object families; correlated variants.
Public probe excluded all previously decoded heldout families before selection, but author identities and sentence dates are unavailable; external dictionaries may contain words.
Clause cues are bounded authored linguistic priors, not a learned grammar or universal sentence-validity filter. Unknown constructions remain neutral.
Desktop JVM timings vary even for the unchanged baseline, and do not establish Fold7 latency or Android allocation cost.
